_comment: Echo-derived valve runs (valve_in_febio echo_tv_realvalves). Use: export_case.py ... --preset echo_valve. 'args' are exporter defaults (CLI flags still win); 'defaults' go into meta.json for the viewer. Thumbnail pose = start pose (user's choice, 2026-10-16). Cameras are relative to the bounding box: dir = direction from target to camera, dist in bbox diagonals, target = bbox fractions (annulus plane sits near the +z end, papillary points at -z).
